title: Filter order history by date range
description: As a shopper I want to filter my order history by start and end date so that I can find a past purchase quickly.
acceptance_criteria: Selecting a start and end date shows only orders placed within that range, inclusive
If the end date is before the start date, an inline error is shown and the list is unchanged
Clearing the filter restores the full list
If no orders match, the page shows 'No orders found'
